field.label: Pre-authentication Key
field.help: Use a non-reusable auth key and disable expiration (optional). If not specified use AuthURL from Status page

field.label: Advertise Tags
field.help: Comma separated list of ACL tags to register this node with, e.g. tag:server,tag:opnsense (optional). Only used when registering via the AuthURL from the Status page, so leave the pre-authentication key empty. The tags of a pre-auth key are assigned when creating the key instead. You must own the tags in the tailnet ACL. A tagged node is owned by the tag rather than by a user and does not expire, changing tags later requires re-authentication.
